headline: ESEA Annual Federal Programs Presentation and four student disciplinary hearings in executive session.
summary: The meeting covers a vote on the ESEA Annual Federal Programs Presentation. The committee will also enter executive session for four separate student disciplinary hearings, Students A, B, C, and D, with possible votes after each.
items: Vote on ESEA Annual Federal Programs Presentation
Executive session for Student A disciplinary hearing
Possible vote on Student A item

Possible vote on Student B item

Executive session for Student D disciplinary hearing
Possible vote on Student D item

**AGENDA** 
SCHOOL COMMITTEE MEETING SCHEDULED FOR WEDNESDAY, JULY 29, 2026 
AT THE DINGLEY BUILDING, 36 OAK ST., LEWISTON 
Note:  
*A review of all general session meetings can be located at www.lewistonpublicschools.org or copies can be requested at a cost of 10 
cents per page.   
 
1. Call meeting to order on or about 5:30 pm until approximately 8:30. Pledge of Allegiance. 
 
2. To receive and potentially vote on the ESEA Annual Federal Programs Presentation. 
 
3. To enter into executive session to conduct Student A disciplinary hearing [Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I 
§405(6)(B)]. 
 
4. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
5. To enter into executive session to conduct Student B disciplinary hearing [Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I 
§405(6)(B)].  
 
6. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
7. To enter into executive session to conduct Student C disciplinary hearing [Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I 
§405(6)(B)].  
 
8. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
9. To enter into executive session to conduct Student D disciplinary hearing [Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I 
§405(6)(B)].  
 
10. To possibly vote on item discussed in executive session. 
 
11. Adjourn. 
 
ADA Notice: This school district will accommodate members of the public with special needs to participate fully in this 
meeting. Please contact Executive Assistant Cheryl Cornelio (795-4100, Ext.4002) if you have such needs.
